turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]
    C --> C1[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    C1 --> C2[Compress to floor content]
    C2 --> C3[Name evaporated content and function]
    C3 --> C4[Locate operative sentence]
    C4 --> C5[Report ratio, erosion direction, and missing rough edge]
    C5 --> C6[Output finding]
    C6 --> C7[This is a finding, not a draft.]
    C7 --> Z[Stop]

    B -->|Draft prompt or task| D[PROVIDE]
    D --> D1{Mode stated or inferable?}
    D1 -->|No| D2[Ask for HUMAN or MACHINE mode]
    D2 --> D1
    D1 -->|Yes| E[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
    E --> E1{HUMAN mode?}
    E1 -->|Yes| E2[Run the speak test]
    E1 -->|No| F[Check floor]
    E2 --> F
    F --> F1{Floor gaps?}
    F1 -->|Three or fewer| F2[Ask one question naming gaps]
    F1 -->|Four or more| F3[Ask three largest gaps]
    F3 --> F4[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
    F2 --> F5[Wait for answer]
    F4 --> F5
    F5 --> E
    F1 -->|No gaps| G[Compress prompt]
    G --> G1{Cut removed specification?}
    G1 -->|Yes| G2[Revert destructive or decorative cut]
    G2 --> G
    G1 -->|No| G3{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    G3 -->|No| G4{Floor still passes?}
    G3 -->|Yes| H[Contract is minimal]
    G4 -->|No| H
    G4 -->|Yes| G
    H --> I[Output optimized contract]
    I --> J[Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?]

    J -->|Keep negotiating| G
    J -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| K{Execution tools available?}
    K -->|No| K1[Gate stays closed; do not fake a run]
    K -->|Yes| L[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    L --> M{Result}
    M -->|Success| N[Done]
    M -->|Floor failure| O[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    O --> G
```

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: D2 -> D1, J -> G
